plan.notes: SOURCE: Official NDSU University Catalog 2024-2025 (archived edition). Semester sequence transcribed from the official catalog 'Sample Program Guide' for Criminal Justice (Total Credits: 120); course titles verified against the official Criminal Justice requirements table (undergraduate/program-curriculum/criminal-justice). HONESTY NOTE: NDSU labels these 'Sample Program Guide' with a disclaimer that they are not the official curriculum for current students; individual plans vary. This is the only semester-by-semester sequence NDSU publishes for this major. The sample plan includes a minor (seven 3-credit minor slots plus one 'minor or 300-400 level elective' slot); a minor is not a published degree requirement, it is how the sample plan fills elective space. CJ 406/407/460/461/465 footnotes: accelerated B.S.-to-M.S. students take the graduate versions (CJ 606/607/660/661/665). Using CJ 494 or CJ 496 for the CJ elective requires department chair permission.
